approveForAll(address,bool).details: MUST emit the ApprovalForAll event on success.

params.approved: True if the operator is approved, false to revoke approval
params.operator: Address to add to the set of authorized operators

params.account: The address of the token holder

returns._0: The account's balance of the token type requested

params.accounts: The addresses of the token holders

returns._0: The account's balance of the token types requested (i.e. balance for each (owner, id) pair)

params.amounts: Transfer amounts per token type (order and length must match _ids array)
params.ids: IDs of each token type (order and length must match _values array)

returns._0: The total supply of token id

approveForAll(address,bool).notice: Enable or disable approval for a third party ("operator") to manage all of the caller's tokens.

balanceOf(address,uint256).notice: Get the balance of an account's tokens.

balanceOfBatch(address[],uint256[]).notice: Get the balance of multiple account/token pairs

batchTransferFrom(address,address,uint25.notice: Transfers `amounts` amount(s) of `ids` from the `from` address to the `to` address specified
